name: Mac mini M6
label: Base Mac mini M6
memoryConvention: The nominal 16 GB DRAM configuration is represented as 16 GiB in the RAM model; this is not a measurement of usable memory.
gpuReferenceLabel: Mac mini M6 CPU + NVIDIA H100 SXM
gpuBandwidthBasis: NVIDIA H100 SXM peak on-device memory bandwidth: 3.35 decimal TB/s = 3,350 GB/s. PCIe and NVL variants are not substituted. VRAM capacity is descriptive and is not a separate model input.

cpuBenchmark.basis: One published run explicitly identifying the base 12-core CPU / 12-core GPU / 16 GB / 256 GB configuration; not an aggregate or Geekbench 7 conversion.

interpretation: CPU reference uses the base Mac mini M6 CPU score and 16 GB RAM. GPU reference is a hypothetical basket adding one H100 SXM's memory bandwidth to that host baseline. It is not an actual Mac-with-H100 configuration, a rental quote, or a guarantee of equal application performance.
limitations: The CPU reference is one macOS Geekbench 6.7.1 result on SME-capable hardware; the fitting sample uses compatible Linux results without SME. The target score is an external performance proxy, not a new training observation.

The GPU model uses H100 SXM's theoretical 3,350 GB/s memory bandwidth, not a GPU Geekbench score or VRAM capacity. This exceeds the eligible fitting sample's bandwidth range, so the reference price extrapolates. The hypothetical 16 GB Mac-class host plus one H100 is not an observed cloud shape; marginal input ranges do not establish joint support.
The same reference resource basket is applied to every historical date; it does not describe past Mac mini generations or pre-launch H100 rental prices. Early fits extrapolate to this bandwidth.
